calibration.reviewer: Codex numerical/audio-onset review; no human listening performed
calibration.method: 15 sections: local autocorrelation, phase scoring, onset snapping, explicit endpoint review of identity/count harmonic ambiguity, boundary-gap inspection.
calibration.audio_inspection: Original media/song.mp3 decoded with FFmpeg. Initial independent 2048-sample rFFT scan found ~0.459s autocorrelation in all broad sections; packaged 1024-sample features resolve transient timing more finely.
calibration.cue_policy: Copy lyrics.json start values exactly; never snap vocal/semantic events to instrumental beats. 12 execution cues are three groups of four; six counts and six departures are separate kinds.
calibration.time_origin: First decoded PCM sample, no additional MP3 encoder offset. Decoder count 4672542 / 22050 = 211.90666666666667s; declared end rounded to 211.906667s.
calibration.beat_position: Continuous ordinal between stored nonuniform beats; extrapolate first/last interval at edges, but generate pulses only for stored beats. No phase reset at a section boundary. Half time uses beat_position / 2.
calibration.title_policy: Onset-backed title transitions chosen near existing staging; remaining semantic transitions preserve lyric/accepted-plan boundaries.
calibration.final_execution: Exact lyric start 205.811, independently of the nearby instrumental transient at 205.69.
limitations: Onset peak is a numerical spectral-growth maximum, not a guaranteed perceptual downbeat; typical grid resolution is 9.977ms.
Symmetric windows/smoothing may anticipate acoustic attacks slightly; semantic cue envelopes are strictly causal.
Organic/identity contain weak/syncopated attacks; retained local peak jitter is intentional and requires listening/visual acceptance.
No full-song human listening, audiovisual acceptance, or beat-meter/downbeat validation has been performed.
Beat pulses end at the last supported outro beat; beat_position continues through the residual tail.

boot_review.selection: First substantial onset at 0.179592 followed by four strong peaks at 0.309297, 0.768254, 1.227211 and 1.696145. POWER is weaker than the following four checks; strengths preserve normalized measured onset values.
boot_review.independent_check: Re-decoded first two seconds of original media/song.mp3 at 22050 Hz; 1024-point periodic Hann rFFT, 110-sample hop, positive magnitude flux at adjacent-center midpoints. Selected feature peaks are within 7.5 ms of raw flux peaks.
boot_review.semantics: POWER, MEMORY, IDENTITY, SIGNAL and CONSCIOUSNESS are authored visual checklist labels, not words detected in the audio. Timing is audio-onset reviewed numerically only.

execution_visual_review.evidence: User accepted the revised side-by-side video; not a full-song beat-meter/listening review.
